description: This file is a script in JavaScript utilizing Node.js modules. It inspects and verifies the boundaries and references of web search providers within the codebase, collecting inventory data, analyzing imports, and performing consistency checks related to web search provider registry boundary definitions.

methods.name: collectWebSearchProviderBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Asynchronously collects inventory data about web search provider boundary references across specified source files, caching the result for multiple calls.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads and parses the baseline inventory JSON file, returning its contents or an empty array if the file does not exist.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Compares actual collected inventory against expected baseline data, returning the differences.

methods.name: runWebSearchProviderBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Performs the boundary check process, integrating inventory collection, comparison, and formatting functions, triggered from CLI or test harness.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point executing the boundary check, optionally exiting the process based on the result.
